title: Vertex AI Agent Builder and Google ADK

videos.script: Google's offer has the same two halves as OpenAI's. Vertex AI Agent Builder is the hosted side, with Agent Engine to run agents on Google Cloud. The Agent Development Kit, ADK, is the open-source library, and it is what runs here. {{title}} The library's tools are plain Python functions, and what it sends is the Gemini API's format: a function's result goes back as a structured object, not as text. {{wire}} Its defaults differ from the other two. A tool that raises an exception ends the whole run, unless a callback turns the error into a result. {{errors}} A refund that needs a person stops the run, and a second run carries the answer back. A callback in front of the tools refuses a large refund before anybody is asked. {{refund}} Then the two ways to involve a specialist, transferring control or calling it as a tool, and what each one passes across. And a workflow where a step that needs no model is plain code. {{team}} And last, the three libraries side by side, and how to choose. {{last}}
